stories.title: Flights returning to normal after nationwide ground stop, FAA says. Here's what to know
stories.summary: Officials attributed the ground stop to aging system infrastructure and legacy technology.

stories.title: Casting call held in Detroit for film featuring Looze Cannon
stories.summary: Hundreds of people turned out for an open casting call in Detroit on Sunday, hoping to land a role in a new film featuring Detroit creator Looze Cannon.

stories.title: Billy Evans, in first interview, tells his side of "You Can See Everything," its portrayal of Elizabeth Holmes
stories.summary: In his first TV interview, Billy Evans, partner of disgraced Theranos co-founder Elizabeth Holmes, talks about his characterization in the documentary "You Can See Everything," as well as threats he says have been made against his family's safety.

stories.title: 2 people dead, man detained after shooting in Roseville
stories.summary: Two people are dead and a man is in police custody after a shooting in Roseville, Michigan, early Sunday, according to city officials.

stories.title: Lions fans flock to German restaurant Dakota Inn in Detroit for overseas game
stories.summary: In their first-ever game in Germany, the Detroit Lions were victorious against the New England Patriots. Because of the time difference, fans got to check out all the action at a local German restaurant early Sunday morning.

stories.title: In wake of nationwide ground stop, Duffy seeks funding to upgrade ATC system
stories.summary: U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy says the Federal Aviation Administration needs billions of dollars to fix the communications issues behind Friday’s nationwide ground stop. Gwen Baumgardner reports on what caused the problems and what’s next.

stories.title: Clouds clear overnight
stories.summary: A sunny start to a warming week

stories.title: Why Lions fans packed a German restaurant in Detroit
stories.summary: The Detroit Lions put on a show in Munich, Germany, on Sunday, beating the New England Patriots 35-10. While plenty of fans made the trip overseas, others flocked to a German restaurant in Detroit to take in the action. Veronica Ortega explains.

stories.title: "They killed my wife": Husband of soldier killed in Kuwait blames command for her death
stories.summary: This week, the families will finally be briefed on the results of the U.S. Army investigation into the strike.

stories.title: 2 killed in Roseville shooting, police say; 1 detained
stories.summary: Two people are dead and a man is in police custody after a shooting in Roseville, Michigan, early Sunday. Julia Avent spoke with residents who live near the home where the victims were found.

stories.title: 2 men sentenced in fatal 2025 shooting at Detroit's Skinner Playfield
stories.summary: Two men have been sentenced in connection with a 2025 shooting at Detroit's Skinner Playfield that killed two people, including a 4-year-old boy, court records show.

stories.title: Michigan troopers who fatally shot gunman in 2025 acted in self-defense, Attorney general's office says
stories.summary: The Michigan Department of Attorney General said troopers who fatally shot a 54-year-old man after he fired at law enforcement in Otisville last year acted in self-defense and defense of others.
